eligibility_rules: each atom has exact source revision and locator
each atom is bound to an immutable digest
installed count is not interpreted as running count
generic air or nitrogen curves are not helium evidence
missing auxiliary power is not zero and is not back-solved
83 kW bidder package statement is target evidence, not independent reconstruction
pass_condition: PV-01..PV-10 are source-bound and semantically compatible at one 2K-OP package boundary
fail_closed_condition: any required atom missing, provisional, contradictory, cross-bidder, or non-helium surrogate
